scope: Xcode-built iOS/iPadOS reference host launched in iOS Simulator runtimes: Metal drawable presentation, ordered Latin+CJK font stack, scene activation and deterministic repaint, graceful retirement and process exit

checks.name: ipad_launch_metal_frame_safe_area
checks.detail: UIView.safeAreaInsets now query through the live window handle: top 32, bottom 20 points; root fills the viewport and uses the insets as padding. Metal frame read back from the drawable.

checks.name: iphone_launch_metal_frame_safe_area
checks.detail: Safe area top 62, bottom 34 points on the Dynamic Island phone; content 402x682 at y=62. Metal frame read back from the drawable.

checks.name: activation_and_deterministic_repaint
checks.detail: Engine-level tap at the button centre activates the scene; the host renders the pressed frame from about_to_wait because a CAMetalLayer view may not deliver another UIKit RedrawRequested. Both devices report frames=2 activations=1 retired=true.

checks.name: narrow_screen_text_layout
checks.detail: Auto-height text nodes replaced fixed heights after the first iPhone run showed the Chinese line wrapping over the button; the final iPhone frame renders the title, the Chinese line and the 激活 Activate button without overlap.

checks.name: chinese_font_stack
checks.detail: Compiled-in DejaVuSans + DroidSansFallbackFull render the Chinese title/line/button with real glyphs on both devices.
